title: Dragging on the canvas with a row picked moves that whole animation
goal: Now that every change on an animated layer becomes a key, there has to be a way to move a whole animation somewhere else. Picking a row by its name and then dragging the layer on the canvas should shift every key of that row by the same amount (for Position, the whole path), as the user accepted when they chose "any change keys itself".
notes: From a-layer-s-track-shows-only-what-is-animated-and (2026-10-14). The mock video-animate.html interaction table row: "Drag on the canvas, a row picked | Canvas | Moves every key of that row by the same amount (for Position, the whole path), instead of keying the playhead." The decision card a-layer-s-track-shows-only-what-is-animated-and-when-you-change-something-on-a-l (answered a) names this as its mitigation. Picked row state: EditorState.pickedKeyRow / keyRowInHand (EditorState+OnlyAnimated.swift); canvas edits go through foldingIntoKeys -> PhotonzDocument.editPosedForCanvas -> foldEditIntoKeys (PropertyKeys.swift). The row menu Easing today lists KeyEase (keyLaneMenuRows in EditorState+KeyLanes.swift).
acceptance: With a row picked by its name, a drag on the canvas moves every key of that row by the same amount instead of keying the playhead, in one undo step
For Position the whole path moves; for Scale and Rotation every key changes by the same amount
With no row picked, a drag keys at the playhead as it does now
The row right-click Easing lists the same curves a key and a segment offer (video-animate.html, the interaction table)
A walk picks the Position row, drags the title on the canvas, and checks every Position key moved

log.note: Adversarial review before building: a Premiere/AE user moves a whole path by selecting every Position key and dragging the layer; here picking the row by its name stands for that, per the mock table. Mock assumes nothing the app lacks: picked-row state already existed. Collision checked: a canvas drag with a row picked previously keyed the playhead; now shifts. Tool bar typed values and arrow nudges are NOT canvas drags and still key the playhead (left as-is; asked in the audit's evaluate).

Built: PhotonzCore/PickedRowShift.swift (PhotonzDocument.editShiftingRow runs the normal posed fold on a scratch copy, reads how far the picked row's value at the playhead moved, and puts the row back with every key shifted by that amount; LayerMotion.shiftingEveryKey; scale floored at 1%). EditorState.foldingIntoKeys gained onTheCanvas, passed true from the four canvas paths in EditorState+LayerDrag. Row right-click Easing now uses segmentCurveRows over every segment of the row (shared list + Hold + Draw a Curve + Copy/Paste Ease). New walk step expectRowKeys (remember / movedSince), lock-safe.

Verified: 9 new core tests (ShiftingAPickedRowTests) + parse test; Scripts/test.sh 13101 tests green; picked-row-drag-moves-whole-path-walk ok (both Position keys moved by exactly 0, 90; still 2 moments; undo restores; Easing > Ease out quint lands and is ticked); only-what-is-animated-walk, key-lanes-walk, key-lanes-menu-walk ok.

Left rough (not filed, below the bar): during the drag the floated sprite shows the layer moving but the timeline diamonds/panel only update on release; with Scale picked the shift is additive percent (audit asks the user).

Shipped in d4e15ffd. With a row picked by its name, a canvas drag moves every key of that row by the same amount (Position: whole path; Scale/Rotation: same amount on every key) in one undo step; with no row picked it keys the playhead as before. Row right-click Easing now lists the shared curve list a segment offers. Core: PhotonzCore/PickedRowShift.swift (9 tests). Verified: Scripts/test.sh 13101 green; picked-row-drag-moves-whole-path-walk ok at Next defaults (both keys moved by 0,90, still 2 keys, undo restores, Easing > Ease out quint ticked); only-what-is-animated, key-lanes, key-lanes-menu walks ok.
